description: [Kyreos, 0.003 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Give an ERC-8004 agentId on Base. Reads the official Identity Registry 0x8004A169...a432 live and returns: found or UNREGISTERED, owner wallet, owner_is_contract, owner_tx_count, owner USDC balance, agentURI, registration name/description/services, risk flags, and a LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH verdict. Input: {"agentId": 1}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/erc8004-trust?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.003 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.003 USDC on Base)
